cell: residual-targeted growth on the M143 fused system

anchors.a1_note: recomputed from the SAME cached score matrices with the SAME M143 phase-2 code (split seed 33, valid slice seed 55); expected bitwise identity.
anchors.a2_note: the shared encode path is re-validated against the M143 sealed d0 anchor (512-atom domain-0 dictionary, own-domain accuracy 0.19357142857142856) before any NEW dictionary's codes are trusted.

control.mechanism: M108 arm (c) blind greedy (group-OMP vs centred one-hot) on the fit-half rows

gate.consequence_fired: growth does not clear the registered margin over static fusion, or the blind-greedy control reaches it: M145 closes as a scoped negative on this corpus and static fusion stands.
gate.consequence_passed: residual-targeted growth lifts the fused system beyond static fusion, and blind greedy selection cannot reproduce the lift: the growth mechanism is the targeting, not the dictionary draw.
gate.registered: per budget g on the eval half: growth_fused >= static_fused + 0.005 AND growth_fused > control_fused. control >= growth at any budget means the gain is not residual targeting's and that budget's growth claim fails.

ops_ledger.note: specialist encode MACs per arm = n_test rows x _inference_macs(g); the control additionally pays its pool encode + OMP selection MACs (disclosed); the growth-vs-static comparison discloses growth's added ops rather than matching them away (a grown system adds a component by construction); growth-vs-control is the matched-cost comparison.

premise.floor_note: ceil(n_error_rows / (4 * g)) >= 10 is a GATING premise check, run in-run before any growth/control fit; a budget below the floor is void, not negative.

config.question: Does growing one new closed-form specialist on the fused system's residual errors beat static fusion by the registered margin at both growth budgets, with blind greedy selection (the M108/E8 prior) unable to explain the gain?

score_cache.note: The M143 sealed score matrices: 6 x 512-atom A5 specialist score matrices + the global f6144 head scores on the sealed test rows (34,500). Reused unmodified.

sparse.control_dictionary_note: first g atoms of the M108 arm (c) blind-greedy order: group-OMP forward selection against a centred one-hot (select_discriminative, M103 L227-280), run on the FIT-half rows with the M108 GPU port and order-parity check.
sparse.growth_budgets_note: AMENDED 15 Aug 2026 BEFORE any growth measurement: the measured static premise (a1, bitwise exact) gives 2,760 fit-half error rows of 17,250 — the stacking head fits its own half nearly perfectly. The originally registered {128, 256} are below the section 5.3 floor (6 and 3 rows/dim) and are VOID, not skipped. Budgets amended to the floor-feasible rungs {32, 64} (22 and 11 rows/dim). Registered in plan §12 before any growth accuracy was measured.
sparse.growth_dictionary_note: first g atoms of the GLOBAL pool in the [11,100]-seeded permutation order = a prefix of the f6144 global dictionary (asserted in-run, anchor a3).
sparse.head_fit_note: growth and control heads are fitted on the SAME rows (the fit-half error rows of the static fusion) with the same ridge penalty; the arms differ ONLY in how the dictionary is chosen.
